season-24-twilight-trails@pokemon-go-cal.details:
Welcome to Pokémon GO: Twilight Trails!
In Pokémon GO, Seasons are periods of time that feature new events, Pokémon debuts, and surprises that all follow a certain theme. As the Seasons change, you may find different Pokémon appearing in your area and hatching from Eggs. Make sure to explore during each in-game Season to collect and train as many different Pokémon as you can! You’ll also enjoy special bonuses as you do.

━━ BONUSES ━━
▸ GO Pass Major Milestone Bonuses
Reach Major Milestones on your GO Pass to unlock the following bonuses. Once unlocked, these bonuses will last until the current GO Pass ends!

▸ Rank 1
• One guaranteed Candy XL when trading Pokémon for Trainers level 31 and above
• One additional Candy for trading Pokémon

▸ Rank 25
• Increased limits on opening Gifts, receiving Gifts from PokéStop and Gym Photo Discs, and storing Gifts

▸ Rank 50
• 2× Daily Adventure Incense duration

▸ Rank 75
• Increased XP and Stardust from hatching Eggs

━━ FEATURES ━━
▸ Pokémon Debuts
More Pokémon originally discovered in the Paldea region, which was featured in the Pokémon Scarlet and Pokémon Violet games for Nintendo Switch, have been spotted in Pokémon GO!
Be on the lookout for Maschiff, Mabosstiff, and more!
Pokémon: Maschiff, Mabosstiff

▸ Mega-Evolved Pokémon
Where Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale ends, a new trail begins! Gather ‘round for the Mega Evolution debuts of Staraptor, Chandelure, and more during Twilight Trails.
Stay tuned for more details on how to continue your Mega Evolution journey with the Mega Squads event, September Community Day Classic, and more!

▸ Max Pokémon Debuts
Dynamax Rhyhorn, Dynamax Sneasel, Dynamax Sizzlipede, and more will make their way into Max Battles throughout the Season. Keep an eye out for new Dynamax Pokémon at Power Spots!
Dynamax Uxie, Dynamax Mesprit, and Dynamax Azelf will appear in a Max Battle Day during Twilight Trails.
Pokémon: Rhyhorn, Sneasel, Uxie, Mesprit, Azelf, Sizzlipede

▸ Daily Discoveries
Throughout Twilight Trails, different days of the week will include a Daily Discovery experience. These will be active between 12:00 a.m. and 11:59 p.m. local time unless otherwise stated. Daily Discoveries may change as Scopely Explore experiments with how to make the best experience.
Please note: Daily Discoveries will not be available during the week of global GO Fest, GO Wild Area, and GO Tour events. Daily Discoveries will not take place from November 9 through November 15, 2026.

▸ Community Days
Mark your calendar! Twilight Trails will have Community Day events on the following dates.
• September 12 — September Community Day Classic
• October 10 — October Community Day
• November 21 — November Community Day

▸ GO Pass
GO Pass, a limited-time progression track, will be available during Twilight Trails! Complete Pass Tasks to earn GO Points to increase your rank and earn rewards.
…

━━ SPAWNS ━━
▸ Wild Pokémon Encounters
As the Seasons change, you may find different Pokémon appearing in your area. Explore during Twilight Trails to see what discoveries await!

━━ EGGS ━━
Here are some of the Pokémon hatching from Eggs this season.
There are more Pokémon appearing in Eggs than the ones listed.

▸ In 2 km Eggs
Pokémon: Elekid, Magby, Azurill

▸ In 5 km Eggs
Regional: Mime Jr. is exclusive to Eggs obtained in Europe.
Pokémon: Mime Jr., Munchlax, Larvesta, Sizzlipede, Snom, Indeedee (Male), Indeedee (Female), Fidough, Maschiff

▸ In 5 km Eggs from Adventure Sync Rewards
Pokémon: Tyrogue, Sableye, Budew

▸ In 7 km Eggs
Pokémon: Galarian Meowth, Galarian Zigzagoon, Galarian Stunfisk

▸ In 7 km Eggs From Route Rewards
This type of Egg is obtained from Mateo’s Gift Exchange at the end of a Route.
Pokémon: Galarian Slowpoke, Hisuian Sneasel, Galarian Corsola

▸ In 10 km Eggs
Pokémon: Dratini, Honedge, Impidimp

▸ In 10 km Eggs from Adventure Sync Rewards
Pokémon: Bagon, Druddigon, Drampa

pokemon-x-adidas-2026@pokemon-go-calenda.details:
Celebrate the adidas × Pokémon collection with Timed Research at participating adidas and retail stores worldwide!
Research is available starting September 25, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. local time, through January 15, 2027, at 8:00 p.m. local time.

━━ FEATURES ━━
▸ Participating adidas Store Locations
Visit a participating location and open Pokémon GO to receive the research.
Search for a store, mall, or city in the store name, or use your location to explore nearby stores. Select Gyms or PokéStops to filter the map.
The interactive map will load when it is near the screen.
Open the official map

▸ adidas Shoes
Complete your outfit! Trainers worldwide can redeem offer code ADIDASxPOKEMON through the Pokémon GO Web Store to get a pair of adidas shoes for their avatar.
This offer code can be redeemed until Friday, January 15, 2027.

━━ RESEARCH ━━
This Timed Research has three pages. Complete the tasks to earn adidas avatar items, Lucario Candy, Lucario Mega Energy, XP, Stardust, and an encounter with Lucario. If you’re lucky, you may encounter a Shiny Lucario!
Obtain the research by January 15, 2027, at 8:00 p.m. local time. Complete all tasks and claim all rewards before February 13, 2027, at 8:00 p.m. local time.

go-pass-october-2026@pokemon-go-calendar.details:
Kyogre makes waves and the Lucky Trinket returns in GO Pass: October!
The GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe for October will be available from October 6, 2026 at 10:00 am to November 3, 2026 at 10:00 am local time.

━━ FEATURES ━━
▸ GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe
Trainers will automatically receive GO Pass: October on Tuesday, October 6, at 10:00 a.m. local time. You can collect GO Points and rank up to get additional rewards through Tuesday, November 3, at 10:00 a.m. local time.
Additionally, from Saturday, October 31, at 12:00 a.m. to Sunday, November 1, at 11:59 p.m. local time, there’s no daily limit for how many GO Points you can earn!
For US$7.99*, Trainers can upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe, a paid version of the GO Pass that offers upgraded rewards and faster progression.
For US$9.99*, Trainers can upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe + 10 Ranks to also automatically earn enough GO Points to reach Rank 11.
While progressing through the GO Pass Deluxe, you’ll be able to claim all of the rewards from both the free GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe. You can upgrade to a GO Pass Deluxe at any time and still collect rewards from previously unlocked ranks.
Rewards unlocked in the GO Pass will expire on Thursday, November 5, at 10:00 a.m. local time, so be sure to claim your rewards before they’re gone!

▸ Featured Pokémon and Rewards
Complete Pass Tasks to rank up your GO Pass to earn the following rewards.
• Encounter with Kyogre*
• Rare Candy XL
• Premium Battle Pass
• Lucky Egg
• And even more goodies!
Trainers who upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe can also earn the following rewards.
• A Lucky Trinket
• One Super Incubator
• Additional encounters with even more Pokémon!
• And even more goodies!

▸ Major Milestone Bonuses
Reach Major Milestones on your GO Pass to unlock the following bonuses.

▸ Tier 1 – Rank 1
• One additional Candy for trading Pokémon
• Trainers level 31 and above will receive one guaranteed Candy XL when trading Pokémon

▸ Tier 2 – Rank 25
• Open up to 40 Gifts per day
• Receive up to 125 Gifts per day from spinning PokéStop and Gym Photo Discs
• Hold 10 more Gifts in your Item Bag

▸ Tier 3 – Rank 50
• 2× Daily Adventure Incense duration

▸ Tier 4 – Rank 75
…

━━ GO PASS ━━
Earn points to increase your rank and unlock rewards. You can earn points by completing Pass Tasks or the various accomplishments listed here. Any rewards you earn for completing a Pass Task will be awarded as soon as you finish the task.
Trainers will also have access to Weekly Tasks to earn points and increase their rank. The Weekly Tasks are as follows:
• Catch 75 Pokémon - 200 PTS
• Win a raid - 150 PTS
• Make 20 Great Throws - 150 PTS
• Hatch 3 Eggs - 150 PTS
• Spin 25 PokéStops or Gyms - 100 PTS
• Use 20 Berries to help catch Pokémon - 100 PTS
• Earn 10 hearts with your buddy - 150 PTS
There is also a daily task:
GO Pass: October Daily
• Catch 15 Pokémon - 200 PTS
GO Pass Deluxe: October Daily
• Catch 15 Pokémon - 200 PTS
Trainers can earn up to 250 extra points daily by completing certain tasks.
• Win a raid - 100 PTS
• Hatch an Egg - 40 PTS
• Catch a Pokémon - 5 PTS

▸ GO Pass: October
Encounter Kyogre!

Mega Chandelure makes its Pokémon GO debut during Chandelure Super Mega Raid Day on Saturday, October 31, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time!

━━ BONUSES ━━
• Remote Raid limit increased to 20 from Friday, October 30, at 5:00 p.m. to Saturday, October 31, 2026, at 8:00 p.m. PDT
• Receive up to six free Raid Passes from spinning Gym Photo Discs
• Chandelure caught from Super Mega Raids will have Mega Level 1 unlocked
• Increased chance of encountering Shiny Chandelure from Super Mega Raids

▸ Event Ticket
For US$4.99 (or the equivalent pricing tier in your local currency), you can purchase a ticket that grants the following bonuses.
• Receive up to 14 Raid Passes from spinning Gym Photo Discs
• Increased chance to get Rare Candy XL from Raid Battles
• An additional 5,000 XP from Super Mega Raid Battles
• An additional 5,000 Stardust from Super Mega Raid Battles
These bonuses will be effective on Saturday, October 31, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time.
Tickets can be gifted to friends at Great Friends or higher. Purchases, including gifts, are non-refundable, subject to applicable law and the Terms of Service. Tickets cannot be purchased with PokéCoins.
The in-game ticket will be available until Saturday, October 31, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. local time.

━━ FEATURES ━━
▸ Mega Chandelure Debut
Mega Chandelure, a Ghost- and Fire-type Pokémon, will make its Pokémon GO debut in Super Mega Raids.
Pokémon: Mega Chandelure

▸ New Mega Level: Super Max
Mega Chandelure can reach Super Max Level for the first time. Raise its Mega Level to Max first, then use Chandelure Mega Energy to reach Super Max. Mega Evolving alone will not be enough; participating in Mega Raids provides the additional Mega Energy you need.

▸ Ominous Wind+
Chandelure can use the additional Charged Attack Ominous Wind+ while Mega Evolved.
• Trainer Battles: 50 power, with a chance to raise the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage.
• Gyms and Raids: 145 power.
The attack becomes more powerful as Chandelure’s Mega Level increases.

▸ Global Challenge
Complete Raid Battles alongside Trainers worldwide to finish Global Challenge tiers. The challenge runs from Friday, October 30, at 5:00 p.m. to Saturday, October 31, 2026, at 8:00 p.m. PDT.
The completed tiers determine the strength of the following rewards, available from Monday, November 2, at 12:00 p.m. to Sunday, November 15, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. PST:
• Mega Chandelure at Mega Level 1 or higher will receive a boost to Ominous Wind+’s base power. This bonus does not apply in GO Battle League.
• Mega Chandelure at Super Max Level will receive a CP boost.
Completing more tiers increases the boosts. Exact boost amounts have not been announced.

━━ RAIDS ━━
▸ Featured Pokémon
Mega Chandelure will appear in Super Mega Raids. After defeating it, Trainers can encounter Chandelure with Mega Level 1 unlocked.
Pokémon: Mega Chandelure

Timed Research will be available during the event, with rewards including one Premium Battle Pass and an encounter with Tyranitar.
The tasks and other rewards below are expected based on Staraptor Super Mega Raid Day and will be confirmed when the event begins.
Complete the Timed Research tasks and claim their rewards before the research expires.

━━ SHINY ━━
Trainers will have an increased chance of encountering Shiny Chandelure from Super Mega Raids.

pokemon-go-wild-area-2026-sendai-japan@p.details:
GO Wild Area returns in 2026 with Steel- and Dragon-type Pokémon, the debuts of Gigantamax Duraludon, Dynamax Dialga, and Dynamax Palkia, and powerful mighty Pokémon. Collect GO Safari Balls to help catch these challenging encounters!
Dates: November 6, 7, or 8, 2026 Time: 10:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m. JST (UTC+9) Location: Sendai, Japan, with gameplay throughout Miyagi Prefecture Ticket: ¥4,000 (including applicable taxes and fees) for one day
All event gameplay is exclusive to ticket holders. A standard ticket covers one selected day; Extra Day add-ons extend eligible gameplay to additional days. Gameplay is available only within the event area at the date and time specified on your ticket.
Ticket registration: Register from September 11 at 8:00 a.m. JST through September 15, 2026, at 7:59 a.m. JST. Registered Trainers will be notified of their purchase window afterward. Tickets are first come, first served, and registration does not guarantee availability. Read the ticket registration announcement.

▸ Related Events

━━ BONUSES ━━
▸ Ticket Holder Bonuses
The following bonuses apply from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. local time on your ticketed event day.
• Increased chance to encounter Shiny Pokémon
• 1/2 Hatch Distance for Eggs placed in Incubators during the event
• Up to 10 free Raid Passes per day from Gyms
• 3/4 Max Particle cost for unlocking and powering up Max Moves
• Daily Max Particle collection limit increased to 8,000
• Increased Max Particles from Power Spots and exploration
• Increased chance of 10 km Eggs from PokéStops and Gyms
• Lure Modules last for 2 hours
• Incense, excluding Daily Adventure Incense, lasts for 2 hours
• 2× Candy for catching Pokémon
• Party Play lasts for 8 hours
• Chance to encounter mighty Pokémon on Routes
• 3 GO Snapshot surprise encounters per day
• Chance to get GO Safari Balls from PokéStops and Gyms

▸ Trading Bonuses
Ticket holders receive these benefits from 12:00 a.m. to 11:59 p.m. local time on their ticketed event day.
• Up to 6 Special Trades per day
• 1/2 Stardust cost for trades
Shiny encounters are not guaranteed. To use the increased exploration Max Particle bonus, first collect all available Max Particles in the Nearby menu. Adventure Sync can help track exploration distance.

into-the-wild-2026@pokemon-go-calendar.details:
It’s time to head back Into the Wild for a Steel- and Dragon-type adventure! Regidrago makes its Dynamax debut in five-star Max Battles, Dynamax Meltan debuts in GO Pass: Into the Wild, and Crowned Sword Zacian and Crowned Shield Zamazenta take over five-star raids as Pokémon GO Wild Area 2026 approaches.

▸ Related Events

━━ BONUSES ━━
• Remote Raid limit increased to 30 from Monday, November 9, to Friday, November 13, 2026
• No Remote Raid limit from Saturday, November 14, to Sunday, November 15, 2026
• Chance to encounter Shiny Gimmighoul when using a Coin Bag*
• Chance to encounter Shiny Meltan when opening the Mystery Box*
• Reduced wait time before you can open the Mystery Box again*
• Trainers can receive special event stickers from PokéStops and Gifts
* These bonuses will be available from Monday, November 9, at 10:00 a.m. to Sunday, November 15, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. local time.
Daily Discoveries will not take place from November 9 through November 15, 2026.

━━ FEATURES ━━
▸ Dynamax Pokémon Debuts
Regidrago will make its Pokémon GO Dynamax debut in five-star Max Battles, and Meltan will make its Dynamax debut in GO Pass: Into the Wild. If you’re lucky, you may encounter a Shiny one!
Pokémon: Regidrago, Meltan

▸ Meltan and the Mystery Box
The Mystery Box is the key to catching Meltan. You can get one by sending a Pokémon from Pokémon GO to Pokémon HOME, or to Pokémon: Let’s Go, Pikachu! or Pokémon: Let’s Go, Eevee! on Nintendo Switch.
From Monday, November 9, at 10:00 a.m. to Sunday, November 15, at 6:00 p.m. local time, opening the Mystery Box gives you a chance to encounter Shiny Meltan, and you won’t have to wait as long before you can open it again.

▸ New Special Background!
Trainers who take part in five-star raids and five-star Max Battles during the Into the Wild event will have a chance of receiving a new Special Background after a successful catch. The souvenir background appears on the Pokémon’s summary page, showing when it was caught on the road to Pokémon GO Wild Area!

▸ Into the Wild Global Challenge

gbl-twilight-trails_great-league_ultra-l.summary: GBL: Great League, Ultra League: Mega Edition, and 2026 GO LAIC Cup
gbl-twilight-trails_great-league_ultra-l.details:
The Great League, Ultra League: Mega Edition, and 2026 GO LAIC Cup will run from November 10, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. to November 17, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. PT.

▸ Great League
• Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.

▸ Ultra League: Mega Edition
• Pokémon must be at or below 2,500 CP to enter.
• Mega-Evolved Pokémon are allowed.

▸ 2026 GO LAIC Cup
• Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
• Fire-, Dark-, Steel-, and Fairy-type Pokémon are not eligible.
• Legendary Pokémon, Mythical Pokémon, and Ultra Beasts are not eligible.
• Mega-Evolved Pokémon are not eligible for the GO Battle League version of this Cup. However, Mega-Evolved Pokémon will be eligible for the Pokémon Latin America International Championships 2026 in-person competition.
The following Pokémon will not be allowed.
Pokémon: Chansey, Snorlax, Furret, Wobbuffet, Galarian Corsola, Kingdra, Medicham, Altaria, Dusclops, Jellicent, Araquanid, Oranguru, Annihilape, Clodsire

pokemon-go-wild-area-2026-global@pokemon.details:
GO Wild Area returns in 2026 with Steel- and Dragon-type Pokémon, the debuts of Gigantamax Duraludon, Dynamax Dialga, and Dynamax Palkia, and powerful mighty Pokémon. Collect GO Safari Balls to help catch these challenging encounters!
Dates: November 14 and 15, 2026 Time: 10:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m. local time each day Location: Worldwide
All Trainers can participate in the global event. An optional US$11.99 ticket adds Special Research, increased Shiny chances, extra Incense encounters, and additional bonuses across both days. Purchase a ticket from the Pokémon GO Web Store.

▸ Related Events

━━ BONUSES ━━
▸ Bonuses for All Trainers
The following bonuses apply from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. local time on both event days.
• Chance to get GO Safari Balls from PokéStops and Gyms
• Up to 3 free Raid Passes per day from Gyms
• Daily Max Particle collection limit increased to 1,600
• 3 GO Snapshot surprise encounters per day
• Party Play lasts for 8 hours
• Chance to encounter mighty Pokémon on Routes
Daily Discoveries will be paused from November 9 at 12:01 a.m. through November 15, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. local time.

▸ Additional Ticket Holder Bonuses
These benefits apply from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. local time on both event days. The ticketed Raid Pass and Max Particle limits replace the free limits.
• Increased chance to encounter Shiny Pokémon*
• Daily Max Particle collection limit increased to 3,200
• Increased Max Particles from Power Spots and exploration**
• Up to 6 free Raid Passes per day from Gyms
• GO Safari Balls instead of Premier Balls for raids and Max Battles***
• 2× Candy for catching Pokémon
• 2× Incense duration
• Increased chance of 10 km Eggs from PokéStops and Gyms
• 6 GO Snapshot surprise encounters per day
• Lure Modules last for 2 hours
*Shiny encounters are not guaranteed. **To use the increased exploration Max Particle bonus, first collect all available Max Particles in the Nearby menu. Adventure Sync can help track exploration distance. ***GO Safari Balls replacing Premier Balls after raids and Max Battles is based on how ticketed GO Wild Area events worked in previous years and is not yet confirmed.

▸ Trading Bonuses
Ticket holders receive these benefits from 12:00 a.m. to 11:59 p.m. local time on both event days.
• Up to 6 Special Trades per day
• 1/2 Stardust cost for trades

━━ FEATURES ━━
▸ Gigantamax Duraludon Debuts
Gigantamax Duraludon makes its Pokémon GO debut at Pokémon GO Wild Area! This larger-than-life Pokémon will appear in six-star Max Battles during the event.
Ticket-holding Trainers can learn more about Gigantamax Duraludon in the event-exclusive Special Research story. Complete it for an encounter with Gigantamax Duraludon with a Special Background!
If you’re lucky, you may encounter a Shiny one!
Pokémon: Gigantamax Duraludon

▸ Dynamax Dialga and Dynamax Palkia
Dynamax Dialga and Dynamax Palkia make their Pokémon GO debuts during GO Wild Area 2026. Both can be Shiny!
For Global, Dynamax Dialga appears on Saturday, November 14, and Dynamax Palkia appears on Sunday, November 15.

▸ Private Dynamax Battle Groups
Starting with GO Wild Area 2026, Dynamax Battle lobbies offer Battle to match automatically with other Trainers or Private Group to join an existing group using its group code.

▸ Adventure Effects in Battle Lobbies
Starting with Into the Wild, select Adventure Effects can be activated while waiting in a raid or Max Battle lobby. Use Crowned Sword Zacian’s Behemoth Blade or Crowned Shield Zamazenta’s Behemoth Bash Adventure Effect before a Max Battle to help your group.

▸ Machamp Wearing a Modern Jacket
A new costumed Machamp appears in three-star raids during the event. Lucky Trainers may encounter a Shiny one!

▸ Special Backgrounds
After a successful catch from raids or Max Battles, Machamp wearing a modern jacket, Dynamax Dialga, Dynamax Palkia, Reshiram, Zekrom, Kyurem, and Gigantamax Duraludon have a chance to have a new Special Background.

▸ Backgrounds on Your Trainer Profile
Your buddy Pokémon’s eligible Location Background or Special Background can now appear on your Trainer profile, where friends can see it too. Background support rolls out on the following schedule:
• November 6, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. local time: GO Wild Area 2026 Location Backgrounds for Sendai and Mexico City.

minior-showers-leonids-2026@pokemon-go-c.details:
Explore by starlight during the Leonids meteor shower for a chance to encounter Minior in Pokémon GO!
This Minior Shower runs from November 14, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. to November 19, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. local time.

━━ BONUSES ━━
• Increased Stardust for catching Minior
• Increased chance to encounter Minior from 5:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. local time each day

━━ FEATURES ━━
▸ Pokémon Debut
Minior (Yellow Core) will make its Pokémon GO debut during the Leonids meteor shower, beginning November 14, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. local time!
Minior (Green Core) is reportedly also available in the wild during the Leonids.
Minior has seven different core colors: Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Indigo, and Violet. A different core color will debut during each of the six meteor showers listed below. During the Geminids, one core color will debut in the Northern Hemisphere and another in the Southern Hemisphere.
Pokémon: Minior (Yellow Core)
Green Core Minior debuted during the Orionids, and Yellow Core Minior debuts during the Leonids. The core colors for the remaining meteor showers have not been announced.

▸ Explore by Starlight
From 5:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. local time every day during each Minior Shower, shooting stars will light up the in-game sky. During these hours, you’ll have an increased chance of encountering Minior in the wild!

▸ Minior’s Form Changes
Minior begins battles in its Meteor Form. When its health drops below 50%, it changes form and exposes its core.
• Meteor Form: Higher Defense and lower Attack.
• Core exposed: Higher Attack and lower Defense.
Initially, Minior will only be able to change forms when battling Team GO Rocket, team leaders, or in the GO Battle League.
Minior will not be eligible for the 2027 Latin America International Championships.

▸ Annual Meteor Shower Schedule
Minior can appear during the following meteor showers each year. Each shower begins at 5:00 p.m. on its first day and ends at 11:59 p.m. on its last day, in local time.
• Orionids: October 19–24, 2026
• Leonids: November 14–19, 2026
• Geminids: December 11–16, 2026
• Eta Aquariids: May 3–8, 2027
• Southern Delta Aquariids: July 28–August 2, 2027
• Perseids: August 10–15, 2027

━━ SPAWNS ━━
▸ Wild Encounters
You may encounter Minior in its Meteor Form in the wild during the event. You’ll receive 1,000 Stardust for catching Minior.
Pokémon: Minior (Meteor Form)
Minior encounters are more likely from 5:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. local time each day.

━━ RESEARCH ━━
No Timed Research: There is no Timed Research during the Leonids. The Minior Shower Timed Research was only available during the Orionids, the introductory event for Minior Showers.

duolingo-timed-research-2026@pokemon-go-.summary: Pokémon GO and Duolingo Timed Research
duolingo-timed-research-2026@pokemon-go-.details:
Pokémon GO and Duolingo are teaming up! Do at least one Duolingo lesson a day for seven days to earn an offer code for Timed Research in Pokémon GO. Complete the research to earn XP, Stardust, and encounters with Pikachu, Meowth, Chatot, and Lucario that have a Special Background.
Duo’s Pokémon Party, the limited-time Duolingo quest, starts on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. JST (Monday, November 16, at 5:00 p.m. PST).

━━ FEATURES ━━
▸ Duo’s Pokémon Party
Join Duo’s Pokémon Party, a limited-time quest, on the latest version of the Duolingo app. Do a lesson in any course to earn your first reward, then earn a new reward each day that you do at least one lesson. Rewards include up to four Pokémon suits for your Duolingo avatar and an offer code for Timed Research in Pokémon GO.
• Starts: Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. JST (Monday, November 16, at 5:00 p.m. PST)
• Join by: Monday, December 21, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. local time
• Finish the quest and claim rewards by: Tuesday, December 29, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. local time

▸ How to Get the Timed Research
• Join Duo’s Pokémon Party in Duolingo by December 21.
• Do at least one lesson a day on seven different days by December 29.
• Redeem your offer code in the Pokémon GO Web Store.
Offer codes are unique to each Duolingo learner, so there is no shared code to redeem.

▸ Language Tag
Some Pokémon from this Timed Research will have a new language tag on their summary page. Tap the tag to see the Pokémon’s name in other languages.

━━ RESEARCH ━━
Practice a new language with Professor Willow while you complete Pokémon GO tasks. Choose a language, and the research tasks will appear in that language. Look out for Professor Willow’s hints if you get stuck on a task!
Complete tasks to earn XP, Stardust, and encounters with the following Pokémon that have a Special Background.
Pokémon: Pikachu, Meowth, Chatot, Lucario

▸ Choose a Path
After you claim the rewards from step 1, choose a language path: English, Chinese (Traditional), Hindi, Spanish (Latin America), Spanish (Europe), French, Portuguese (Brazil), Indonesian, Russian, German, Japanese, Turkish, Korean, Thai, or Italian. The tasks for the rest of the research will appear in that language. You can choose only one path, and you’ll stay on it until the end of the research.

Tune in to Twitch.tv/PokemonGO on November 20 and 21, or Twitch.tv/Pokemon on November 22, and you’ll earn rewards the longer you watch. Here’s what you can get:

• An encounter with a Samurott inspired by PsyRhino’s NAIC-winning team
• 20 Oshawott Candy
• 20 Oshawott Candy XL
• 10 Charged TMs
• 10 Fast TMs
Watch for 45 minutes: An LAIC Battle Bundle that includes the following.
• 1 Elite Charged TM
• 1 Rare Candy XL
• 25 Charged TMs
• 25 Fast TMs

▸ LAIC Battle Bundle
Trainers who watch for 45 minutes will earn an additional LAIC Battle Bundle containing the following items.*
• 1 Elite Charged TM
• 1 Rare Candy XL
• 25 Charged TMs
• 25 Fast TMs

season-25-daydream-destinations@pokemon-.details:
Welcome to Pokémon GO: Daydream Destinations!
In Pokémon GO, Seasons are periods of time that feature new events, Pokémon debuts, and surprises that all follow a certain theme. As the Seasons change, you may find different Pokémon appearing in your area and hatching from Eggs. Make sure to explore during each in-game Season to collect and train as many different Pokémon as you can! You’ll also enjoy special bonuses as you do.

━━ BONUSES ━━
▸ GO Pass Major Milestone Bonuses
Reach Major Milestones on your GO Pass to unlock the following bonuses. Once unlocked, these bonuses will last until the current GO Pass ends!

▸ Rank 1
• Increased XP from going up a Friendship level
• 2× Friendship bonus damage in raids

▸ Rank 25
• Increased limits on opening Gifts, receiving Gifts from PokéStop and Gym Photo Discs, and storing Gifts

▸ Rank 50
• 2× Daily Adventure Incense duration

▸ Rank 75
• Increased XP and Stardust from hatching Eggs

━━ FEATURES ━━
▸ Pokémon GO Tour: Alola
Pokémon GO Tour returns in February 2027 with a trip to the Alola region!
• Pokémon GO Tour: Alola – Los Angeles — Thursday, February 19, to Saturday, February 21, 2027
• Pokémon GO Tour: Alola – Kaohsiung — Thursday, February 19, to Saturday, February 21, 2027
• Pokémon GO Tour: Alola – Global — Saturday, February 27, and Sunday, February 28, 2027
Trainers everywhere can join the global event. A global event ticket, available on the Pokémon GO Web Store, will grant access to exclusive Special Research, additional bonuses, and an increased chance to encounter Shiny Pokémon.
Check out our Los Angeles, Kaohsiung, and Global event pages for more details.

▸ Mega-Evolved Pokémon
Mega Froslass and Mega Drampa will be featured in Raid Day events during Daydream Destinations. Stay tuned for more details!

▸ Community Days
Mark your calendar! Daydream Destinations will have Community Day events on the following dates.
• December 12–13, 2026 — December Community Day
• January 2, 2027 — January Community Day Classic
• January 16, 2027 — January Community Day
• February 6, 2027 — February Community Day

▸ GO Pass
GO Pass, a limited-time progression track, will be available during Daydream Destinations! Complete Pass Tasks to earn GO Points to increase your rank and earn rewards.
The GO Pass Deluxe, a paid version of the GO Pass, will be available for Trainers looking for upgraded rewards and faster progression.

▸ GO Battle League
The GO Battle League continues during Daydream Destinations, featuring the 2027 Europe International Championships Cup, the Holiday Cup, the Love Cup, and more!

▸ Research Breakthrough
Complete Field Research to unlock Research Breakthrough encounters with one of a variety of Season-themed Pokémon. Discover where your path leads you each week!

━━ MAX BATTLES ━━
▸ Dynamax Pokémon
Dynamax Alolan Sandshrew, Dynamax Slowpoke, Dynamax Corphish, and more will make their way into Max Battles throughout the Season. Keep an eye out for new Dynamax Pokémon at Power Spots!
Pokémon: Alolan Sandshrew, Slowpoke, Corphish

▸ Gigantamax Pokémon
Gigantamax Inteleon and Gigantamax Toxtricity (Amped Form and Low Key Form) will be featured in Max Battle Days during Daydream Destinations. Stay tuned for more details!
Pokémon: Gigantamax Inteleon, Gigantamax Toxtricity

━━ EGGS ━━
Here are some of the Pokémon hatching from Eggs this season.
There are more Pokémon appearing in Eggs than the ones listed.

▸ In 2 km Eggs
Pokémon: Vulpix, Swablu, Yamper

▸ In 5 km Eggs
Pokémon: Lickitung, Snom, Flittle

▸ In 5 km Eggs from Adventure Sync Rewards
Pokémon: Tyrogue, Happiny, Maschiff

▸ In 7 km Eggs
Pokémon: Alolan Geodude, Galarian Corsola, Galarian Zigzagoon

▸ In 7 km Eggs From Route Rewards
This type of Egg is obtained from Mateo’s Gift Exchange at the end of a Route.
Pokémon: Hisuian Growlithe, Hisuian Sneasel, Galarian Corsola

▸ In 10 km Eggs
Pokémon: Honedge, Goomy, Charcadet

▸ In 10 km Eggs from Adventure Sync Rewards
Pokémon: Gible, Drampa, Frigibax

gigantamax-inteleon-max-battle-day-2026@.details:
The Gigantamax Inteleon Max Battle Day event will take place on December 5, 2026 from 2 pm to 5 pm local time.

━━ BONUSES ━━
The following bonuses will be active during the event.
• Max Particle collection limit increased to 1,600
• All Power Spots will host Gigantamax Battles
• Power Spots will refresh more frequently
• Additional Power Spots will be active
• 8× Max Particles from Power Spots
• Up to three Special Trades for the day
• From December 4 at 4:00 p.m. to December 5 at 8:00 p.m. PST (GMT −8), the daily Remote Raid limit will increase from 10 to 20
The following bonuses will be active on December 5, 2026, from 12:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time.
• 2× Max Particles from exploring*
• 1/4 Adventuring distance to receive Max Particles**
*Trainers can collect Max Particles via the Nearby menu each day by exploring. Adventure Sync can help make sure your distance counts! Keep an eye on the Nearby menu for the icon that shows when Max Particles are ready to collect.
**For these bonuses to apply, Trainers must first collect all Max Particles available in the Nearby menu.

▸ Event Ticket
For US$4.99 (or the equivalent pricing tier in your local currency), you’ll be able to access event-exclusive Timed Research.
Timed Research rewards include the following.
• 1 Max Mushroom
• 25,000 XP
• 6,400 Max Particles
You’ll also receive the following bonus.
• 2× XP from Max Battles
This Timed Research will be effective on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time.

━━ FEATURES ━━
▸ Featured Pokémon
The following Pokémon will appear in six-star Max Battles!
Pokémon: Gigantamax Inteleon
For the first time in Pokémon GO, you’ll be able to encounter Shiny Gigantamax Inteleon—if you’re lucky!

▸ Where can I find Max Battles?
Max Battles appear at Power Spots and require teamwork. Use the Pokémon GO Map to find active battles and locations where battles may appear during the event.
You can also check nearby events for community meetups hosted by Community Ambassadors, or find your community to coordinate with other Trainers.

━━ RESEARCH ━━
▸ Paid Timed Research
For US$4.99 (or the equivalent pricing tier in your local currency), you’ll be able to access event-exclusive Timed Research, which rewards 1 Max Mushroom, 25,000 XP, 6,400 Max Particles, and 2× XP from Max Battles.
The Timed Research is available on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time. Tasks have not yet been announced.

━━ SHINY ━━
Shiny Gigantamax Inteleon will be released with the start of the event.
Pokémon: Gigantamax Inteleon

pokemon-champions-celebration-event-2026.details:
Celebrate Pokémon Champions in Pokémon GO with the Pokémon Champions Celebration Event! Look for event-themed wild encounters, raids featuring Pokémon with a Special Background, an event GO Pass, and gifts for sending Pokémon from Pokémon HOME to visit Pokémon Champions.

━━ BONUSES ━━
• Increased chance to encounter Kecleon at PokéStops
Reach Major Milestones on your event GO Pass to unlock the following bonuses.

▸ Tier 1 Bonus – Starting at Rank 1
• 7× GO Transporter Energy gained per hour to send a Pokémon from Pokémon GO to Pokémon HOME

▸ Tier 2 Bonus – Starting at Rank 10
• 2× Candy for catching Pokémon*

▸ Tier 3 Bonus – Starting at Rank 20
• 3,000 additional XP from completing Raid Battles
Upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe to also get the following bonus:
• GO Pass Deluxe: Receive up to two free Raid Passes per day from spinning Gym Photo Discs
Keep an eye out for additional bonus tasks for this GO Pass during the event!

━━ FEATURES ━━
▸ Pokémon HOME and Pokémon Champions
During the collaboration event period, you can transfer a Pokémon caught in Pokémon GO to Pokémon HOME, then send that Pokémon to visit Pokémon Champions to receive a gift in your Pokémon Champions mailbox. See the Pokémon HOME news post for details.

▸ Special Backgrounds
Pokémon encountered from raids during the event may have a Special Background. Five-star raid bosses with the Special Background are only available for the duration of the Pokémon Champions Celebration Event.

▸ GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe
A GO Pass is a free, limited-time progression track available during a specified period. By collecting GO Points, you can increase your rank to earn rewards.
Trainers will automatically receive GO Pass: Collaboration Celebration Event on Tuesday, December 8, at 10:00 a.m. local time. You can collect GO Points and rank up to get additional rewards through Monday, December 14, 2026, at 8:00 p.m. local time.
For US$4.99*, Trainers can upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe, a paid version of the GO Pass that offers upgraded rewards and faster progression.
For US$6.99*, Trainers can upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe + 6 Ranks to also automatically earn enough GO Points to reach Rank 7.
While progressing through the GO Pass Deluxe, you’ll be able to claim all of the rewards from both the free GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe. You can upgrade to a GO Pass Deluxe at any time and still collect rewards from previously unlocked ranks.
Rewards unlocked in the GO Pass will expire on Wednesday, December 16, 2026, at 8:00 p.m. local time, so be sure to claim your rewards before they’re gone!

minior-showers-geminids-2026@pokemon-go-.details:
Explore by starlight during the Geminids meteor shower for a chance to encounter Minior in Pokémon GO!
This Minior Shower runs from December 11, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. to December 16, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. local time.

━━ BONUSES ━━
• Increased Stardust for catching Minior
• Increased chance to encounter Minior from 5:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. local time each day

━━ FEATURES ━━
▸ Minior Cores
Minior has seven different core colors: Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Indigo, and Violet. A different core color will debut during each of the six meteor showers listed below. During the Geminids, one core color will debut in the Northern Hemisphere and another in the Southern Hemisphere.
Pokémon: Minior (Red Core), Minior (Orange Core), Minior (Yellow Core), Minior (Green Core), Minior (Blue Core), Minior (Indigo Core), Minior (Violet Core)
Green Core Minior debuted during the Orionids, and Yellow Core Minior debuts during the Leonids. The core colors for the remaining meteor showers have not been announced.

▸ Explore by Starlight
From 5:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. local time every day during each Minior Shower, shooting stars will light up the in-game sky. During these hours, you’ll have an increased chance of encountering Minior in the wild!

▸ Minior’s Form Changes
Minior begins battles in its Meteor Form. When its health drops below 50%, it changes form and exposes its core.
• Meteor Form: Higher Defense and lower Attack.
• Core exposed: Higher Attack and lower Defense.
Initially, Minior will only be able to change forms when battling Team GO Rocket, team leaders, or in the GO Battle League.
Minior will not be eligible for the 2027 Latin America International Championships.

▸ Annual Meteor Shower Schedule
Minior can appear during the following meteor showers each year. Each shower begins at 5:00 p.m. on its first day and ends at 11:59 p.m. on its last day, in local time.
• Orionids: October 19–24, 2026
• Leonids: November 14–19, 2026
• Geminids: December 11–16, 2026
• Eta Aquariids: May 3–8, 2027
• Southern Delta Aquariids: July 28–August 2, 2027
• Perseids: August 10–15, 2027

━━ SPAWNS ━━
▸ Wild Encounters
You may encounter Minior in its Meteor Form in the wild during the event. You’ll receive 1,000 Stardust for catching Minior.
Pokémon: Minior (Meteor Form)
Minior encounters are more likely from 5:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. local time each day.

december-communityday2026@pokemon-go-cal.details:
Pokémon from Community Days in 2026 return for an end of the year celebration!
The year is nearly behind us, which means it’s time to reflect on all the fun everyone had during this year’s Community Days. If you missed any, now’s your chance to catch up!
The last Community Day of 2026 will take place over two days—Saturday, December 12, 2026, and Sunday, December 13, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time.
Note: The only difference between Day 1 and Day 2 are the Pokémon appearing more frequently in the wild.

━━ BONUSES ━━
• Increased Spawns
• 2x XP for catching Pokémon
• 2x Stardust for catching Pokémon
• 1/2 Hatch Distance when Eggs are placed into Incubators during the event period
• 2x Catch Candy
• 2x Chance for Trainers level 31 and up to receive Candy XL from catching Pokémon
• 3-hour Incense**
• 1-hour Lures*
• Up to two Special Trades can be made per day*
• Trades made will require 50% less Stardust*
* While most bonuses are only active on December 12 and 13 from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time, these bonuses will be active from Saturday, December 12, at 9:00 a.m. to Sunday, December 13, at 9:00 p.m. local time. ** The three-hour Incense bonus excludes Daily Adventure Incense.

━━ FEATURES ━━
▸ Limited-time Evolution Requirement
From Saturday, December 12, at 9:00 a.m. to Sunday, December 13, at 9:00 p.m. local time, evolve Bisharp into Kingambit after defeating 1 Dark- or Steel-type Raid Boss with Bisharp as your Buddy Pokémon.
This Evolution requirement will return to the usual requirement on Sunday, December 13, 2026, at 9:00 p.m. local time.
Pokémon: Pawniard, Bisharp, Kingambit

━━ SPAWNS ━━
A different set of Pokémon will be featured on each event day—Saturday, December 12, and Sunday, December 13, 2026—from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time.
The Pokémon that appear during this time will have the same chance of appearing as a Shiny Pokémon as those that appeared during their original Community Days, and they may also appear with a Special Background. Outside of these times, any of the featured Pokémon may appear from 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. local time on either Saturday or Sunday!
The following Pokémon will be featured on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time.

You might even encounter the following Pokémon!
Pokémon: Gible, Deino

━━ RESEARCH ━━
▸ Field Research Tasks
Field Research leading to encounters with Pokémon featured in Community Days and Community Day Classics in 2026 will be available. These Pokémon may have a Special Background!

▸ December Community Day 2026 Special Research
For US$4.99 (or the equivalent pricing tier in your local currency), you’ll be able to access the December Community Day–exclusive Special Research. Complete this research for rewards including:
• Encounters with Pokémon featured in Community Days and Community Day Classics in 2026 that have a Special Background
• 1 Elite Charged TM
• 1 Elite Fast TM
• 1 Rocket Radar
• And more!
You can purchase and gift tickets to friends you’ve achieved a Friendship level of Great Friends or higher with. To gift a ticket, tap the Special Research ticket in the in-game shop, then tap the Gift button instead of the Buy button.

▸ Community Ambassador Check-In Timed Research

minior-showers-eta-aquariids-2027@pokemo.details:
Explore by starlight during the Eta Aquariids meteor shower for a chance to encounter Minior in Pokémon GO!
This Minior Shower runs from May 3, 2027 at 5:00 p.m. to May 8, 2027 at 11:59 p.m. local time.

━━ BONUSES ━━
• Increased Stardust for catching Minior
• Increased chance to encounter Minior from 5:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. local time each day

━━ FEATURES ━━
▸ Minior Cores
Minior has seven different core colors: Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Indigo, and Violet. A different core color will debut during each of the six meteor showers listed below. During the Geminids, one core color will debut in the Northern Hemisphere and another in the Southern Hemisphere.
Pokémon: Minior (Red Core), Minior (Orange Core), Minior (Yellow Core), Minior (Green Core), Minior (Blue Core), Minior (Indigo Core), Minior (Violet Core)
Green Core Minior debuted during the Orionids, and Yellow Core Minior debuts during the Leonids. The core colors for the remaining meteor showers have not been announced.

▸ Explore by Starlight
From 5:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. local time every day during each Minior Shower, shooting stars will light up the in-game sky. During these hours, you’ll have an increased chance of encountering Minior in the wild!

▸ Minior’s Form Changes
Minior begins battles in its Meteor Form. When its health drops below 50%, it changes form and exposes its core.
• Meteor Form: Higher Defense and lower Attack.
• Core exposed: Higher Attack and lower Defense.
Initially, Minior will only be able to change forms when battling Team GO Rocket, team leaders, or in the GO Battle League.
Minior will not be eligible for the 2027 Latin America International Championships.

▸ Annual Meteor Shower Schedule
Minior can appear during the following meteor showers each year. Each shower begins at 5:00 p.m. on its first day and ends at 11:59 p.m. on its last day, in local time.
• Orionids: October 19–24, 2026
• Leonids: November 14–19, 2026
• Geminids: December 11–16, 2026
• Eta Aquariids: May 3–8, 2027
• Southern Delta Aquariids: July 28–August 2, 2027
• Perseids: August 10–15, 2027

━━ SPAWNS ━━
▸ Wild Encounters
You may encounter Minior in its Meteor Form in the wild during the event. You’ll receive 1,000 Stardust for catching Minior.
Pokémon: Minior (Meteor Form)
Minior encounters are more likely from 5:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. local time each day.
